subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable session-store shape should replace inline full `systemPromptReport` while preserving bootstrap warning dedupe and avoiding retained-row bloat?
rationale: Current source intentionally persists the report for warning dedupe, but field data shows the full report now dominates retained session rows; choosing minimal state versus out-of-line reports is a maintainer storage-policy decision.

options.title: Persist Minimal Warning State
options.body: Store only the warning-dedupe state needed across runs and stop retaining bulky tools, skills, and injected-file report sections in session rows.

options.title: Out-Of-Line Report Blobs
options.body: Use content-addressed or session-scoped report blobs/refs similar to skill prompt blobs, preserving diagnostics without repeating them inline.

options.title: Keep Inline Reports
options.body: Retain the current inline shape and rely on pruning/capping, accepting continued duplicated metadata in retained rows.

recommendation.title: Persist Minimal Warning State
recommendation.body: Store only the warning-dedupe state needed across runs and stop retaining bulky tools, skills, and injected-file report sections in session rows.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history signal for both prompt-report metadata and the current prompt-blob storage mitigation.
